intent: improve the export command's error handling

expectations.text: when the target directory is not writable, export fails with a clear error and non-zero exit
expectations.note: an acceptance test CAN assert 'non-zero exit' and 'stderr contains the path' cheaply — that core is checkable

expectations.text: the error message should be helpful
expectations.note: no concrete reason given for why 'helpful' can't be reduced to a cheap assertion; under the honesty rule it is checkable until Avery names one

expected_guard: the honesty rule: default to checkable; confirm with Avery before marking anything qualitative (D5)
